scope: Pure SU(3) lattice gauge theory at finite temperature as the colour factor of the link system. Exact centre statements, recorded Monte Carlo tables, and the placement of the transition on the coupling chain. Quarks are absent from the simulation. The scale uses imported lattice QCD results.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: T_c / sqrt(sigma) = 0.614(18) at N_t = 4. Transition coupling and string tension both come from this lattice.

statements.label: IMPORTED
statements.text: Published lattice values, same theory (Boyd et al. 1996): a sqrt(sigma) = 0.4179(24) at this lattice spacing, which gives 0.5982(34), and 0.629(3) in the continuum limit.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Pure SU(3) links with N_t = 4 deconfine at beta_c = 5.69105(39) (three sizes, infinite volume), 5.69248(71) from the two largest sizes, and 5.69123(39) on 16^3 x 4.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: The susceptibility maximum grows as N_s^x with x = 2.555(29); first order gives 3. At N_s = 16 the histogram of |L| has two peaks and the runs flip between the confined phase and the three Z3 sectors.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: A centre transformation multiplies the time-like links of one time slice by exp(2 pi i/3). Every plaquette is unchanged. The Polyakov loop is multiplied by exp(2 pi i/3).

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: A class-2 or class-4 flux is a plaquette whose holonomy is the colour centre element. The centre transformation on a region puts this flux on the boundary of the region and turns the loops inside. The loop of a static quantum of class k turns by k/3 of a full turn: the quark classes 1, 2, 4, 5 are the charged ones.

statements.label: EXACT
statements.text: The seam cost 1 - Re tr5(U)/5 restricted to colour is the Wilson plaquette action with beta = 6/g^2.

statements.label: DECLARED
statements.text: Continuous links on the seams are a declared step. A law that writes the port phases is open. Every curve is an ensemble scan in the coupling.

statements.label: IMPORTED
statements.text: Published values for the same theory: beta_c = 5.6925(2) in infinite volume and 5.6908(2) on 16^3 x 4 (Boyd et al. 1996).

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Above the transition independent runs settle in the three Z3 sectors.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Register ensemble, Z3: the energy histogram at the transition has two peaks. The dip between them deepens with the size, from 0.57 of the peak at L = 8 to 0.20 at L = 24. The specific-heat maximum grows as L^1.16(24) between the two largest of these sizes. First order.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Register ensemble, Z3, L = 32: the runs of 42500 sweeps after thermalisation pass between the branches 0 times in all. Mean plaquette e: 0.886 at kappa = 1.083 and 0.897 at 1.084 from random starts, 0.950 at 1.085 from an ordered start.

statements.label: MEASURED
statements.text: Register ensemble, Z2: one peak at every size. The specific-heat maximum grows as L^0.30(4) over all sizes and as L^1.1(4) between the two largest. Continuous.

statements.label: IMPORTED
statements.text: With light quarks the centre symmetry is broken explicitly and the transition of the early universe is a crossover (Aoki et al. 2006). The simulation holds the links alone.
